description: Figure: hydropathy, burial and bundle geometry of ahk1's three predicted TM segments versus real membrane and soluble control proteins
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
B=pd.read_csv("segment_benchmark.csv"); G=pd.read_csv("segment_geometry.csv")
r0=pd.read_csv("res_O14260.csv"); rp=pd.read_csv("res_P09627.csv")
TM=[(277,297),(374,394),(400,420)]
col={"membrane":"#1f6fb4","soluble":"#b45309","ahk1":"#c2185b"}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,3,figsize=(15.5,8))

a=ax[0,0]
a.plot(r0.resi,r0.kd19,lw=1,color="#333")
for s,e in TM: a.axvspan(s,e,color=col["ahk1"],alpha=.25)
a.axhline(1.6,ls="--",color="grey",lw=1); a.axhline(0,color="k",lw=.5)
a.set_title("ahk1 (O14260) hydropathy"); a.set_xlabel("residue"); a.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle, 19-aa window")
a.text(0.02,0.95,"only 277-297 exceeds 1.6",transform=a.transAxes,va="top",fontsize=8)

a=ax[0,1]
a.plot(rp.resi,rp.kd19,lw=1,color="#333")
a.axhline(1.6,ls="--",color="grey",lw=1); a.axhline(0,color="k",lw=.5)
a.set_title("pma1 (P09627), real 8-TM H+-ATPase"); a.set_xlabel("residue"); a.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle, 19-aa window")
a.set_ylim(ax[0,0].get_ylim())

a=ax[0,2]
for i,c in enumerate(["membrane","soluble","ahk1"]):
    y=B[B.cls==c].max_kd19.values; x=np.random.normal(i,0.07,len(y))
    a.scatter(x,y,color=col[c],s=38,zorder=3,edgecolor="w",lw=.5)
    a.hlines(y.mean(),i-.25,i+.25,color=col[c],lw=2)
a.axhline(1.6,ls="--",color="grey",lw=1)
a.set_xticks([0,1,2]); a.set_xticklabels(["real TM\nhelices","soluble\nhydrophobic cores","ahk1\n3 segments"])
a.set_ylabel("peak KD19 of segment"); a.set_title("Segment hydrophobicity")

a=ax[1,0]
for i,c in enumerate(["membrane","soluble","ahk1"]):
    y=B[B.cls==c].mean_rsa.values; x=np.random.normal(i,0.07,len(y))
    a.scatter(x,y,color=col[c],s=38,zorder=3,edgecolor="w",lw=.5)
    a.hlines(y.mean(),i-.25,i+.25,color=col[c],lw=2)
a.set_xticks([0,1,2]); a.set_xticklabels(["real TM\nhelices","soluble\nhydrophobic cores","ahk1\n3 segments"])
a.set_ylabel("mean relative solvent accessibility\n(single-chain AlphaFold model)")
a.set_title("Burial: ahk1 segments have no lipid-facing surface\n(p=0.017 vs real TM helices)")

a=ax[1,1]
for i,c in enumerate(["membrane","soluble","ahk1"]):
    y=G[G.cls==c].mean_pair_angle.values; x=np.random.normal(i,0.07,len(y))
    a.scatter(x,y,color=col[c],s=55,zorder=3,edgecolor="w",lw=.5)
    if len(y)>1: a.hlines(y.mean(),i-.25,i+.25,color=col[c],lw=2)
a.set_xticks([0,1,2]); a.set_xticklabels(["polytopic membrane\nproteins","soluble\nproteins","ahk1"])
a.set_ylabel("mean pairwise helix-axis angle (deg)")
a.set_title("Bundle geometry: 0 deg = membrane-spanning bundle")

a=ax[1,2]
a.plot(r0.resi,r0.rsa.rolling(5,center=True).mean(),lw=.9,color="#444",label="RSA (5-aa mean)")
for s,e in TM: a.axvspan(s,e,color=col["ahk1"],alpha=.25)
a2=a.twinx(); a2.plot(r0.resi,r0.plddt,lw=.8,color="#1f6fb4",alpha=.7); a2.set_ylabel("pLDDT",color="#1f6fb4")
a.set_xlabel("residue"); a.set_ylabel("relative solvent accessibility")
a.set_title("ahk1: the three segments sit in a\nwell-folded, buried region (pLDDT 88-93)")
a.set_xlim(200,500)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
